svg.text: DIMENSIONLESS • CANDIDATE TOPOLOGY • NOT A PRODUCTION MODEL
Six candidate pairs, twelve persistent pane identities.
One 90-degree intake sector at +x; five 54-degree sectors elsewhere.
Count is delegated candidate choice, not book canon. Glass thickness, passage width and scale await production review.
Author: Angelis Pseftis • All views project the same vertices; view framing scales independently.
